privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Responsible under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other national data protection laws of member states as well as other data protection regulations is:

controller.name: VisionAiHub GmbH
controller.managingDirector: Represented by the Managing Director: Yash Shah
controller.registry: Registered: Amtsgericht Frankfurt am Main, HRB 141831

website.heading: a) When Visiting the Website
website.intro: When you visit my website, the browser used on your device automatically sends information to the server of my website. This information is temporarily stored in a so-called log file. The following information is collected without your intervention and stored until automated deletion:
items: IP address of the requesting computer,
Name and URL of the retrieved file,
Website from which access is made (referrer URL),
Browser used and, if applicable, the operating system of your computer, and the name of your access provider.
website.purpose: These data are collected for the purpose of ensuring a smooth connection setup of the website, ensuring comfortable use of our website, evaluating system security and stability, and for other administrative purposes.

form.heading: b) When Using a Contact Form
form.intro: If you use a contact form to reach out to me, I collect the following personal data:
items: Name, email address, and other contact details
form.purpose: This data collection is necessary to answer your questions and handle your inquiries.

cookies.heading: c) Cookies
cookies.intro: This website may use cookies. Cookies are small files that are automatically created by your browser and stored on your device (laptop, tablet, smartphone, etc.) when you visit our site. They do not damage your device and do not contain viruses, trojans, or other malware.
cookies.purpose: The use of cookies serves to make the use of my services more pleasant for you. Some cookies are necessary to run basic website functions, while others may be used for statistical or marketing purposes.
cookies.analytics: This website may use Google Analytics, a web analysis service of Google Inc. Google Analytics uses cookies. You can find more details in Google's Privacy Policy.

sharing.heading: Data Sharing
sharing.intro: Your personal data will not be transferred to third parties for purposes other than those listed above, unless:
items: You have given your explicit consent,
The transfer is necessary for the fulfillment of a contract,
The transfer is necessary for asserting, exercising, or defending legal claims and there is no reason to assume that you have an overriding interest in not disclosing your data.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.label: Right to access:
items.body: Obtain confirmation of whether your data is being processed and, if so, receive further details.

items.label: Right to correction:
items.body: Request the correction of incorrect or incomplete personal data.

items.label: Right to deletion:
items.body: Demand the deletion of your personal data, except when processing is required by law.

items.label: Right to restrict processing:
items.body: Request the limitation of processing if you contest the accuracy of the data.

items.label: Right to data portability:
items.body: Receive the personal data that you provided in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

items.label: Right to withdraw consent:
items.body: Withdraw your consent at any time.

rights.complaint: If you believe that the processing of your data violates data protection law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

security.heading: Data Security
security.body: I use appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from accidental or intentional manipulation, partial or complete loss, destruction, or unauthorized access by third parties. My security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments.

updates.heading: Updates to this Policy
updates.body: I may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in legal requirements or changes to my services. The latest version is available on this website.
